description: Returns the web address of the grading laboratory's own report-check page for a GIA or IGI report number, after checking that the number has that laboratory's format. Use this when the user wants to verify a diamond's grading report themselves. Limits: it only builds the link; it does not open, read or confirm the report, and only GIA and IGI are supported. For an IGI number starting with LG it also notes that such reports are normally for lab-grown diamonds.

lab.description: The laboratory that issued the report.

report_number.description: The report number printed on the report (GIA: 7–10 digits; IGI: 7–10 digits, lab-grown reports may start with LG).

name: check_report

note.description: A reading tip about the number's format; the report itself is the authority.

title: Get a lab report-check link
